description.value: Reinecker campground sits within Herald Park on the forested west shore of Shuswap Lake, offering a roped swimming beach, boat launch, and the self-guided Margaret Falls trail; it is a busy, full-amenity park that fills quickly in summer.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The OSM record names this 'Reinecker campground,' a specific campground within Herald Park (BC Parks), as confirmed by the website URL and content — Reinecker Creek is referenced in the nature trail description. The BC Parks Herald Park page confirms frontcountry camping with a 'Book camping' link and reservation policies section, supporting reservations=true. Most amenity details (showers, water, hiker-biker sites) are not addressed in the fetched website text, so those remain null.
concerns: OSM names this record 'Reinecker campground' but the website URL and content are for Herald Park generally — Reinecker campground appears to be one campground area within Herald Park rather than a standalone facility; the listing may benefit from clarification or merging with a broader Herald Park record.
Phone number (+1-250-320-9305) and email (parkinquiries@telus.net) are for operator Silvertip Park Services Ltd. and are not corroborated by the fetched BC Parks website content.
No civic address is present in the OSM record.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A legitimate BC Provincial Park frontcountry campground in the Shuswap region; a touring cyclist would benefit from this listing as a base camp for the area.
enrichment_extras.notes: OSM tag sanitary_dump_station=yes and internet_access=no noted; the latter is not confirmed by the website. Capacity listed as 35 in OSM tags.

wow_evidence: roped swimming beach, boat launch, and the self-guided Margaret Falls trail
